learningObjective: See how a bounded perturbation can cross a nearby decision boundary even when the original sample is classified correctly.
mediumRationale: A deterministic SVG can show a two-dimensional decision boundary, an l-infinity square, a clean point, and a gradient-directed adversarial point precisely. Mermaid cannot express continuous geometry.

pages.insight: The loss-optimization slide explains gradients as directions in parameter space and introduces two-dimensional loss slices.
The sharpness-aware minimization slide evaluates gradients after a bounded adversarial parameter perturbation, providing adjacent worst-case optimization intuition.
